title: Template Engine
description: Build a template engine with variable interpolation, conditionals, loops, template inheritance, and custom filters.

steps.title: Implement variable interpolation
steps.description: Build a `render(template, context)` function that replaces `{{ variable }}` placeholders with values from the context object. Support dot notation for nested properties like `{{ user.name }}`. Print the rendered output to console.
hints: Use a regex like /\{\{\s*(\w+(\.\w+)*)\s*\}\}/g to match placeholders
Split dot notation and reduce into the context object to resolve nested values
Trim whitespace around variable names and replace undefined with empty string

verification.successMessage: Variable interpolation renders the correct values
verification.failureMessage: Rendered output does not contain expected interpolated values

steps.title: Add conditional blocks
steps.description: Implement `{% if condition %} ... {% else %} ... {% endif %}` blocks. The condition supports basic comparisons: `==`, `!=`, truthy/falsy checks. Support nested conditionals. Print the rendered result of both branches.
hints: Parse tokens between {% %} markers; track if/else/endif nesting depth
Evaluate the condition expression and include or skip the block content
Else is optional — if not present and condition is false, render nothing

verification.successMessage: Conditional blocks render the correct branch
verification.failureMessage: Conditional did not render the expected branch content

steps.title: Implement for loops
steps.description: Implement `{% for item in list %} ... {% endfor %}` loops. Provide access to `loop.index`, `loop.first`, and `loop.last` variables inside the loop body. Support looping over arrays and object keys. Print the rendered list items.
hints: Parse the for expression: the word before 'in' is the loop variable, after is the iterable
Set loop.index (1-based), loop.first, loop.last as local context variables
Use a for-of loop for arrays and Object.keys for objects

verification.successMessage: For loops iterate correctly and expose loop variables
verification.failureMessage: Loop did not render items or loop variables are missing

steps.title: Add filters (upper, lower, capitalize)
steps.description: Implement pipe syntax `{{ name | upper }}` and `{{ name | capitalize }}`. Filters are functions applied to the variable value. Support chaining: `{{ name | lower | capitalize }}`. Add built-in filters: upper, lower, capitalize, trim, default. Print the filtered output.
hints: Split on | to get the variable name and filter chain
Each filter is a function registered in a filters registry
Chaining applies filters left-to-right: result = filter2(filter1(value))

verification.successMessage: Filters transform values correctly and support chaining
verification.failureMessage: Filtered output does not match expected transformed values

steps.title: Implement template inheritance
steps.description: Implement `{% extends "base" %}` and `{% block name %}...{% endblock %}` tags. The child template defines blocks that override the parent template's blocks of the same name. Parent templates can have default block content. Print the composed output.
hints: Store templates in a registry by name; parse extends to load the parent
First parse the child to extract block contents, then render the parent replacing matching blocks
Blocks in the parent that are not overridden keep their default content

verification.successMessage: Template inheritance correctly composes parent and child blocks
verification.failureMessage: Block overriding or parent template loading did not work correctly

steps.title: Add partial includes
steps.description: Implement `{% include "partial" %}` tag that loads and renders another template within the current context. Partials have access to the current rendering context. Support passing additional context: `{% include "item" with { item: item } %}`. Print the composed page.
hints: Load the partial template from the registry and render it with the current context
The with keyword replaces or extends context: merge the additional context into the current
Partials should not have access to the caller's blocks — only the data context

verification.successMessage: Partial includes render correctly with shared context
verification.failureMessage: Partial template did not render or context was not passed correctly

steps.title: Build expression evaluator
steps.description: Implement full expression evaluation inside `{{ }}` and `{% %}` tags. Support arithmetic (`+`, `-`, `*`, `/`), comparison (`==`, `!=`, `>`, `<`, `>=`, `<=`), and logical (`and`, `or`, `not`) operators. Respect operator precedence. Print results of complex expressions.
hints: Tokenize the expression into numbers, strings, operators, and parentheses
Use the shunting-yard algorithm or recursive descent parser for precedence
Support string literals in single or double quotes and boolean true/false

verification.successMessage: Expression evaluator handles arithmetic, comparison, and logical operators
verification.failureMessage: Expression evaluator returned wrong values or failed to parse complex expressions
